title: Worker registration is public behind the shared invoke key and can hijack any worker
description:
POST /orgs/{tenant_id}/workers/register (conversation/src/http/routes/workers.ts:45-60) has no principal; any holder of the CloudFront invoke key can register a worker for any tenant id, including one that does not exist (ensureComputer then creates a computer record for it), and re-registering an existing worker_id silently rotates its token and locks the real worker out. The tenant-mismatch guard at domain/workers.ts:58 is dead code because getWorker is keyed by tenant.

Fix: require the organization to exist and be enabled; require the current bearer token (or a per-organization one-time enrolment secret) to re-register an existing worker_id; delete the dead branch. Gherkin scenarios for the three refusals.
